cases.name: rejects inconsistent AIE2P binding multicast before publication

stdin.text:
aie2p.target<array> @array_target {device_profile = "amd.xdna.strix_halo.17f0_11"}

aie2p.target<core> @core_target

low.func.def public retain target<amd.xdna.aie2p.array>(@array_target) abi(array_program) @binding_multicast_mismatch() asm {
  %zero = constant.u32 0 : reg<aie2p.array.scalar : index>
  %one = constant.u32 1 : reg<aie2p.array.scalar : index>
  %two = constant.u32 2 : reg<aie2p.array.scalar : index>
  %group = group %two
  %worker0 = worker %group, %zero, @consume
  %worker1 = worker %group, %one, @consume
  %input = binding 0, "read"
  %sender = sender %input, 0 : reg<aie2p.array.sender : tile<1xi32>>
  %receiver0 = receiver %worker0, 0 : reg<aie2p.array.receiver : tile<1xi32>>
  %receiver1 = receiver %worker1, 0 : reg<aie2p.array.receiver : tile<1xi32>>
  %channel0 = channel %sender, %receiver0, %one, %one : reg<aie2p.array.channel : tile<1xi32>>
  %channel1 = channel %sender, %receiver1, %two, %two : reg<aie2p.array.channel : tile<1xi32>>
  constrain.location %worker0, %zero, %two
  constrain.location %worker1, %one, %two
  return
}

low.func.def target<amd.xdna.aie2p.core>(@core_target) abi(object_function) @consume() asm {
  return
}
